★Request
Display Still in Love (Racing Racewear)
This is part of that effort, so to speak...
...Trainer.
Ah... Ahh... Trainer...

But if things stay like this forever...
I wondered... if it might become an emotional burden on you, Trainer...
Y-Yes.
...Me, too.
Ah...
...Phew.

Ah... I-I'm sorry.
I tried stepping forward as much as I could to stay in your field of vision, but...
Ah...

Would it have ended differently if it were “her”...?
...Ahh... But then there would be no point...
Even if... No matter what form that might take.
Trainer.

(The other day, even though you went out of your way to invite me
out, Trainer... all I did was cause trouble...)

...I'm all right now.
I'm sorry for startling you...
...To think you only noticed after I stepped right in front of you and blocked your way...

...To think you would embrace me like that.
I...

...Um. T-There's no deep meaning behind it. You could call it
an attempt to change my mindset... I simply thought I'd try to change myself.
Setting changing herself aside, there really shouldn't be any need to force a change in her eating pace. In fact, it's far better than rushing through meals.
We tried with many Umamusume, but none noticed her just by calling out to them. It was as if she was standing in thick fog.

I ended up standing... closer than I intended...
...I must have startled you.

A-Anyway... I'll try speaking to them.
Not from behind, but from as far in front as possible—c-cheerfully!

I tried imitating Oguri-san, but...
I suppose it doesn't come easily...
I-It wasn't your imagi—... Ahh...

...You're comforting me, aren't you...?
Just how gentle and kind... can you possibly be...?

Trainer...
......
Judging from her demeanor, it seemed there were other reasons she wanted to change. Without prying too deeply, I decided to go along with her, but—
With her cheeks puffed full of food, she looked adorable like a squirrel, but forcing herself was never good. I voiced this to the downhearted girl.

(...Both my faint presence, and how I eat.
I was conscious of them, but I never tried to fix them before.)

I cannot let... something like that happen again...
I have to do something...

Why was she doing this when she usually took her time eating...?
Curious, I asked her the reason. To which—

—Noon. Heading to the cafeteria, I made eye contact with Still in Love,
who was desperately shoveling food into her mouth.

So you can rest easy, and there's no need to worry.
Because once the surprise fades, I truly feel happy inside.

Saying that, I began my own meal.
Slowly, matching Still in Love's usual relaxed pace.

It's not that her footsteps are silent, nor does she have an inconspicuous appearance.
Even so, most people fail to notice her presence.

(And yet, ...
I mustn't simply indulge in your kindness...)

—Could the true intention behind “wanting to change herself”
actually stem from her fear of “becoming a burden”?

Ah, ...
Still... I thought I'd give it another try.

I'm sorry... for making you worry...
...Thank you for being here with me, Trainer.
Still in Love looked down apologetically.

I peered into her face, placing each other clearly in view.
As if to reassure her that there was nothing to worry about, that everything was all right.
(I want to accept you too. Every single part of you, just as you are.)

...Please, don't apologize.
After all... I'm the one at fault here.

...Hm? Did someone just call me?
There's nobody around, though... Guess it was just my imagination.

Man, I've been running like crazy since morning~!
Not that it stops here, 'cause I'm gonna run some more... All right, let's do this~!

Ah... phew...
...Trainer... to think you had to see something so embarrassing...

At that moment, Still in Love choked.
Panicked, I rushed over and rubbed her back to help her settle down.

Ngh, ahem... *cough*.
E-Excuse me! Do you have a moment...!

...Um. Don't you... dislike it?
Do you get tired... being around me...?

U-Um, excuse me...!
Could I just talk to you for a—
Ngh! *cough*, *cough*...!

(A comforting warmth, as if floating in gentle waters.
An absolute trust that makes me feel safe no matter where I am, as long as I'm with you.)

(And yet... I can't just keep taking what's given to me.
If you accept me just as I am...)

...
...My Trainer.
Haah... I thought... I was going to choke...

Changing my eating speed was difficult, so next...
I want to fix my faint presence... so people will finally notice me...!
Ngh, *gulp*... *munch*...
—The next day.
